description: Delete multiple fields from an Airtable table in a single call. Each entry requires fieldId and expectedName as a safety guard (deletion is refused if names do not match). Fields are processed sequentially and all are attempted even if some fail — partial results are always returned. Optionally writes a JSON checkpoint file after each deletion so the batch can be resumed if interrupted.

checkpointFile.description: Absolute path to a JSON file updated after each deletion. Stores remaining fields so the batch can be resumed after a crash.

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

fields.description: Fields to delete. Each entry must have fieldId and expectedName.

expectedName.description: Expected name — deletion is refused if it does not match

force.description: When true, delete each field even if it has downstream formula/rollup dependencies. Default: false.

name: delete_fields
